links.outcome: Clinician outreach success and time from suicide risk alert to outreach
links.effect: Phase 1: outreach mean 11.2 min after alert, 25/81 (30.9%) reached. Phase 2: 284 alerts among 172 participants; 73/172 (42.4%) contacted; mean 11.5 min to outreach. Many alerted participants were not reached.

unlisted_practices: Universal pre-treatment PHQ-9 suicide screening before chatbot use, with escalation of positive screens to a human clinician

links.outcome: Successful clinician contact and time from suicide-risk detection to outreach initiation
links.effect: Phase 1: contact 25/81 participants (30.9%); mean outreach initiation 11.2 minutes. Phase 2: contact 73/172 participants (42.4%); average outreach initiation 11.5 minutes. Operational escalation was feasible, but most alerted participants were not successfully contacted.

links.outcome: time to outreach and successful contact rate
links.effect: Outreach to at-risk individuals was initiated in an average of 11.2 minutes in phase 1 and 11.5 minutes in phase 2.
links.quote: Proactive, universal suicide risk screening and conversational detection using a human-in-the-loop protocol can be operationally implemented for individuals utilizing a Generative AI mental health chatbot.
